question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus the new SDK token-budget helpers as the stable narrow `ContextEngine.assemble` contract now, or fold token headroom into the broader assemble metadata RFC?
rationale: This is a public plugin SDK/context-engine contract change and the repository already has an open broader RFC for related assemble metadata, so automation cannot choose the stable API shape.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve this focused token-headroom contract, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Broader RFC
options.body: Pause this PR and handle token count, provenance, and live-turn metadata together in the broader assemble metadata design.

options.title: Keep Helpers Private For Now
options.body: Avoid adding public SDK exports until maintainers settle which token-budget helpers should be stable plugin API.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve this focused token-headroom contract, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, authored the current reviewed head, and have the strongest recent history on the exact context-engine budgeting path.
